newsitem.title: UK: India buys 650,000 t Feb diesel, trade estimates.
newsitem.headline: India buys 650,000 t Feb diesel, trade estimates.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) appears to have bought about 650,000 tonnes of high speed diesel for February delivery, traders quoting preliminary indications of tender results said on Friday.
They said 17 cargoes had been awarded, with Galaxy receiving four and BB Energy one. Two of Galaxy's were for delivery in the second week of February and two were for the final week of the month.
Traders could not immediately identify other companies awarded cargoes.
For deliveries to India's east coast, price levels were around fob high quotes +$28 basis Mediterranean, traders said.
India's recent diesel imports included 120,000 tonnes in October, none in November, 520,000 tonnes in December and 345,000 tonnes in January.
Traders have said that in the tender for 1.0 percent sulphur diesel, which closed on December 18, most offers were based on the high of Mediterranean spot quotes rather than Middle East spot quotes.
